escenas.texto: This week in Asia, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over three hundred and seventy-eight million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Asia edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Asia. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. In position number ten, from Japan, Saito, with “Bottle Flip”. Over twelve million views. A Short of just fifteen seconds. It also has seven hundred and thirty-seven comments.
Number nine, from Indonesia, Cici & Mas Bule, with a video posted six days ago. Over thirteen million views. A Short of just forty-eight seconds. It also has two hundred and thirteen comments.

Number eight, from India, Neetu Bisht, with a video posted one day ago. Over thirteen million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one million, two hundred thousand views per hour. It got there in just one day.

At number seven, from United Arab Emirates, dami, with “Dad vs. toddler vs. the cat: who made the best print?”. Over fifteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about five thousand, seven hundred subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just sixteen seconds.

Coming in at number six, from South Korea, K덕톡, with a video posted four days ago. Over fifteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about fifty-three thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just forty seconds.

Coming in at number five, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, with a video posted six days ago. Over sixteen million views. A video over twenty-nine minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over eleven thousand comments.

Coming in at number four, from South Korea, 가방고리고도리, with a video posted four days ago. Over seventeen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and seventy thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-five seconds.
Bronze medal, from South Korea, RESCENE, with a video posted four days ago. Over nineteen million views. A Short of just ten seconds. It also has over one thousand comments.
Silver medal, from India, Maddock Films, with “Sisuse me!!! Shraddha Kapoor Eetha in cinemas 4th December”. Over twenty-seven million views. It also has over one thousand comments.

And here it is. Number one most viewed, from India, Techno Gamerz, with “My first day in vice city gta 6 gameplay”. Over thirty-six million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: three out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over one hundred and twenty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Coming in at number ten, لانا و رورو, with a video posted six days ago. Over five thousand comments. A video over twenty-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over two point five million views.

Coming in at number nine, from South Korea, T1, with a video posted one day ago. Over six thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about two hundred and forty thousand views per hour. It got there in just one day.

Coming in at number eight, バズチェック, with a video posted three days ago. Over six thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about seventeen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just sixty seconds.

Coming in at number seven, from India, The Roamer Amit, with a video posted four days ago. Over seven thousand comments. A video over fifty-five minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over three point one million views.
Coming in at number six, from South Korea, MarvelKorea, with a video posted two days ago. Over nine thousand comments. It got there in just two days. It also has over four point four million views.

Number five, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, with a video posted six days ago. Over eleven thousand comments. A video over twenty-nine minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over sixteen million views.

Next up, number four, from South Korea, CORTIS, with a video posted one day ago. Over thirteen thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: nineteen out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It got there in just one day.

Bronze medal, from India, Shivang Mini, with a video posted one day ago. Over fourteen thousand comments. A video over twenty-three minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just one day.
Silver medal, from Japan, なにわ男子, with a video posted three days ago. Over twenty thousand comments. It also has over one point four million views.

Drum roll, please. Number one most commented, from India, Techno Gamerz, with “My first day in vice city gta 6 gameplay”. Over fifty-four thousand comments. A video over one hundred and twenty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over thirty-six million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Number ten, from South Korea, CORTIS, with a video posted one day ago. Over one hundred and ninety-two thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: nineteen out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It got there in just one day.

Number nine, from India, Neetu Bisht, with a video posted one day ago. Over one hundred and ninety-seven thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one million, two hundred thousand views per hour. It got there in just one day.
Next up, number eight, from India, The Laughter Show, with a video posted three days ago. Over one hundred and ninety-seven thousand likes. It also has over eight point five million views.
Number seven, from Japan, Bayashi TV, with “Minions Tortilla Hat”. Over two hundred and twenty-one thousand likes. A Short of just thirty-five seconds. It got there in just one day.

Coming in at number six, from India, Whimsy Aangan , with a video posted five days ago. Over two hundred and twenty-four thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over eight point four million views.

Number five, from India, FactTechz, with a video posted three days ago. Over two hundred and forty-three thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-two seconds. It also has over seven point six million views.

Coming in at number four, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, with a video posted six days ago. Over two hundred and sixty-two thousand likes. A video over twenty-nine minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over sixteen million views.

Bronze medal, from India, resham info, with a video posted five days ago. Over two hundred and sixty-seven thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about forty-seven thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over eight point three million views.
Silver medal, from India, Aman Sharma , with a video posted five days ago. Over three hundred and thirteen thousand likes. It also has over nine point two million views.

And here it is. Number one most liked, from India, Techno Gamerz, with “My first day in vice city gta 6 gameplay”. Over one million likes. A video over one hundred and twenty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over thirty-six million views.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Africa. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Asia every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
